name: Donnie Thurman
bio: Hey, I'm Donnie! A Visual Communication Designer, creative thinker, and problem solver. I'm passionate about the intersection of creativity, strategy, and technology, and love turning big ideas into thoughtful designs that make people stop and look. From building brand identities to designing digital experiences, I'm all about intentional design, clever details, and creating work I'm genuinely proud of. Have a project in mind? I'm your girl!
